english.title: Throw / discharge stone etc to take or kill fish
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[threw]_
(B)_[discharged]_

(C)_[a stone]_
(D)_[a missile, namely **(..SPECIFY..)]_

for the purpose of

(E)_[taking or killing]
(F)_[facilitating the taking or killing]

of salmon, trout, eels, lampreys, smelt, shad, freshwater fish and any specified fish in any waters
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1)(c) and (2) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
